text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kenyan Foreign Minister Kalonzo Musyoka warns foreign envoys to keep out of Kenya's internal matters, referring to recent condemnation by 14 embassies of police brutality.
- A minister at the presidency, Jackson Kalweo, says he has given instructions barring Administration Police from carrying guns and regular police from carrying live bullets.
- President Daniel arap Moi speaks out against tribalism.
- Opposition Ford Asili party treasurer, Haroun Lempaka defects to ruling party KANU party.
- Opposition Ford Kenya party says they are ready to go it alone in the coming general elections if no semblance of opposition unity is worked out.

- Ford Kenya party rejects a proposition by the Opposition Alliance to invite an international negotiator to mediate on a single opposition presidential candidate to stand against Moi in general elections expected some time this year.
